2610.07091.title: Smart Content Ingestion for Generative AI Workloads
2610.07091.paper_summary: The evolution of machine learning has progressively changed where intelligence resides in an AI system. In conventional machine learning the task, data representation, labels and model architecture were tightly coupled, so data preparation was narrow, schema-bound and visible. Generative AI decouples the model from any single task: one foundation model serves open-ended downstream tasks, and the generality gained on the model side is matched by heterogeneity on the data side, because enterprise knowledge is authored in the formats people use (PDF, presentations, spreadsheets, scanned documents, forms, tables, diagrams and mixed-layout files) that carry textual, visual, geometric and structural information at once. A language model or retriever cannot reason reliably over information misrepresented at this interface, so content extraction becomes a lifecycle stage in its own right whose errors no downstream retriever or re-ranker can repair. This paper presents a production-ready content-extraction system that makes this stage explicit, configurable, and measurable. The system incorporates selective OCR routing, a scarcity-first curation engine with a reference-based extraction scorer that measures character, word, and table-structure accuracy, a deterministic structure-aware parent-child chunker, and a read-only retrieval evaluator that generates grounded questions from every page and reports Hit@k, mean reciprocal rank, and latency. On a 180-document corpus the best extractor scores 97.4 of 100 (character error rate 0.13%, table similarity 0.995) and the chunker reaches hit@1 of 68.6%, hit@10 of 92.8% and MRR 0.77 over 25,050 generated questions. We distil three design principles (structure before semantics, never mutate what you measure, budget your labels) and position measured content extraction as the perception layer of enterprise agentic systems.
2610.07091.paper_summary_zh: 機器學習的演變逐漸改變了智慧在人工智慧系統中的位置。在傳統的機器學習中，任務、數據表示、標籤和模型架構是緊密耦合的，因此數據準備是狹窄的、架構綁定的且可見的。生成式人工智慧將模型與任何單一任務解耦：一個基礎模型服務於開放式的下游任務，而在模型方面獲得的通用性與數據方面的異質性相匹配，因為企業知識是以人們使用的格式（PDF、簡報、電子表格、掃描文件、表單、表格、圖表和混合佈局文件）創建的，這些格式同時攜帶文本、視覺、幾何和結構信息。語言模型或檢索器無法可靠地推理在此接口上錯誤表示的信息，因此內容提取成為一個獨立的生命周期階段，其錯誤無法被任何下游檢索器或重排序器修復。本文提出了一個可生產的內容提取系統，使這一階段變得明確、可配置且可測量。該系統包含選擇性OCR路由、一個以稀缺性為首的策展引擎，具有基於參考的提取評分器，測量字符、單詞和表格結構的準確性、一個確定性結構感知的父子分塊器，以及一個只讀的檢索評估器，從每一頁生成有根據的問題並報告Hit@k、平均互惠排名和延遲。在一個包含180份文件的語料庫中，最佳提取器的得分為100中的97.4（字符錯誤率0.13%，表格相似度0.995），而分塊器在25,050個生成問題中達到hit@1的68.6%、hit@10的92.8%和MRR 0.77。我們提煉出三個設計原則（結構優先於語義、永遠不改變你所測量的、預算你的標籤），並將測量的內容提取定位為企業代理系統的感知層。
